notes: Continuity index injected into context so the model keeps a coherent map of its own history. Kimi/OpenRouter long-reasoning streams no longer time out mid-generation. Reasoning-replay models (Kimi, MiniMax) no longer narrate tool calls they didn't make. New per-model context-size selector when loading local models. Local GGUF capabilities (tools/vision) now resolved from the file itself — works offline; vision enabled only when a companion mmproj projector and reachable mtmd path are present.
